title: Add plural resource items_imported_count
description: Add the plural resource used to localize the AI-import success toast ("%1$d item imported!" / "%1$d items imported!").
acceptance_criteria: app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml gains a <plurals name="items_imported_count"> with "one" item "%1$d item imported!" and "other" item "%1$d items imported!"
exact_code:
<plurals name="items_imported_count">
        <item quantity="one">%1$d item imported!</item>
        <item quantity="other">%1$d items imported!</item>
    </plurals>
